Regulatory Lead
Remote, with occasional travel as required | Full-Time

About Us
Reactive Markets is the 2026 OTC Trading Platform of the Year (Risk.net). Our network handles over $75 billion in daily trading volumes across FX, Equities, and Cryptocurrency, connecting 60+ of the world's leading liquidity providers.
We build trading systems that operate at the edge of what's technically possible — where nanoseconds matter and a dropped message costs real money. Our engineering team is small, senior, and deeply invested in the craft of building cutting edge, reliable, high-performance systems.

The role
We are looking for a Regulatory Lead to take day-to-day ownership of our regulatory framework, and of our relationship with our external compliance provider, as the business grows.
This is a broad, hands-on role covering regulatory change, compliance processes, governance and risk across the UK and US. The successful candidate will work closely with the CEO, our Compliance Officer and MLRO, the senior leadership team, external legal and regulatory advisers, and sophisticated institutional clients and counterparties.

Key Responsibilities
• 
Take day-to-day ownership of the firm’s regulatory framework across the UK and US, prioritising work through a central plan and dashboard.
• 
Monitor regulatory developments affecting the business, assess their impact and lead the implementation of any changes required.
• 
Work with our external compliance provider to keep compliance policies, procedures and controls up to date and applied in practice, including marketing and financial promotions approvals, client categorisation and onboarding, employee compliance (such as personal account dealing, conflicts of interest and gifts and hospitality) and compliance records.
• 
Oversee the compliance monitoring carried out by our external provider, act on its findings, and keep records and evidence ready for regulatory and client due-diligence review.
• 
Support the MLRO and our external provider in running the firm’s financial crime framework, including anti-money laundering, sanctions and client due diligence.
• 
Assess the regulatory implications of new products, jurisdictions and business initiatives, and coordinate specialist advice where needed.
• 
Act as a point of contact for regulators and for clients’ and counterparties’ compliance and regulatory teams, including responding to due-diligence questionnaires.
• 
Coordinate compliance training with our external provider and promote a strong compliance culture across the business.
• 
Prepare regulatory and compliance reporting for the Board and senior leadership, and support corporate governance processes.
• 
Manage external legal and regulatory advisers, instructions and budgets, including on contractual, data protection and other matters requiring legal input.
• 
Identify opportunities to improve compliance processes through templates, automation and technology.

About you
You will have substantial experience in a regulatory or compliance role, whether gained at a fintech, crypto or digital-asset business, a trading firm, bank or broker, a regulator, an advisory or consultancy firm, or a combination of these. A legal qualification is welcome but not required.
Experience in trading, markets, payments or digital assets is desirable. A strong working knowledge of UK regulatory frameworks, sound regulatory judgement and the ability to translate regulatory requirements into practical business processes will be essential. Exposure to US regulation would be an advantage.
You should have:
• 
Experience of compliance frameworks, policies and monitoring, including working with or overseeing outsourced compliance providers.
• 
Experience managing regulatory change and assessing the regulatory impact of new products or business activities.
• 
Excellent written communication skills, including drafting clear policies, procedures and reports.
• 
The confidence to work independently and exercise sound judgement.
• 
The ability to recognise when specialist legal advice is needed, and to work effectively with external counsel.
• 
A practical, solutions-focused approach, with the ability to explain regulatory requirements clearly to colleagues across the business.
• 
The ability to engage confidently with regulators, sophisticated clients, counterparties and their compliance or regulatory teams.
• 
Experience managing external advisers and coordinating work across multiple jurisdictions.
• 
An interest in financial markets, trading technology and regulatory developments.
The role would suit someone who wants meaningful responsibility in a growing business and enjoys building a well-organised, effective regulatory function rather than simply responding to individual queries.

How to Apply
Please apply directly via this job posting — all applications, including those submitted via LinkedIn, are managed through our applicant tracking system, so you'll always land in the same place regardless of where you found this role.
Right to Work: Candidates must have the existing right to work in the UK. We are not currently able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.
Smartsheet is looking for an experienced Senior Data Scientist II to build the ML models and AI sub-agents that drive growth, monetization, efficiency, and retention across the customer lifecycle. You’ll work end-to-end framing problems, building models across the modern ML and deep learning toolkit, designing sub-agents that reason and act, and shipping all of it into production for millions of users. The data is unusually rich: petabyte-scale execution data spanning two decades of how real work gets done. You are curious, technically rigorous, and can translate complex modeling and sub-agent behavior into clear recommendations for your partners. You will work primarily with Product and Engineering and will be a part of Smartsheet’s Business Intelligence team.

This full-time position will report to a Data Science & BI Leader and can be located in our Bellevue, WA office, or you may work remotely from anywhere in the US where Smartsheet is a registered employer.

You Will:

• Design and ship AI sub-agents that act across the customer lifecycle, combining predictive models, retrieved context, and LLM reasoning to recommend or take action

• Build the predictive and prescriptive models that power those sub-agents  churn risk, growth, adoption trajectories, account health scoring, and similar lifecycle problems

• Develop the data foundations and knowledge layer those sub-agents reason over, applying responsible aggregation and privacy-aware design

• Design the tools, retrieval, and grounding strategies each sub-agent uses; decide when a sub-agent should act, recommend, defer, or escalate

• Build the evaluation harnesses that determine when a sub-agent is good enough to ship and that catch regressions in production

• Define metrics and experimentation strategy for sub-agent rollouts; measure real customer impact, not just offline accuracy or eval scores

• Partner with Product, Engineering, and Applied AI teams from problem framing through production deployment

• Drive a data and modeling culture within Product and Engineering, and mentor other data scientists on the team

• Understand our customer needs and design metrics to analyze how our customers are using product and optimize products and features

• Conduct experiments, causal studies and A/B tests to measure the impact of product changes

You Have:

• Bachelor’s degree and 8+ years of experience (or 10+ years of experience); advanced degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, CS, ML, Economics, Operations Research, or similar) preferred

• Deep applied ML expertise across both traditional ML and deep learning: gradient boosting, regularized linear models, transformer-based sequence models, foundation model embeddings, causal ML, contextual bandits, and offline RL

• Strong grasp of causal inference for intervention design and lifecycle modeling: uplift modeling, difference-in-differences, propensity scoring, and synthetic control

• Solid foundation in statistics and experimental design: hypothesis testing, power analysis, multiple comparisons, sequential testing, and quasi-experimental methods

• Hands-on experience taking LLM- and agent-based systems to production: tool use, retrieval, multi-step reasoning, evaluation, and guardrails

• Experience operating ML in production — feature engineering and pipelines, model monitoring, drift detection, retraining cadence, and the trade-offs between batch and real-time serving

• Proficient in SQL and Python; comfort with ML/LLM tooling at scale (Spark, Databricks, Snowflake, or equivalents), ML frameworks (PyTorch, scikit-learn, XGBoost/LightGBM), and visualization tools (Tableau or similar)

• Experience modeling the customer lifecycle — churn, expansion, adoption, plan health, lead/account scoring — and business fluency in the SaaS metrics that drive it (NRR, GRR, ARR, and cohort economics)

• A pragmatic production bar: latency, cost, monitoring, drift, hallucination, and what happens when the model or sub-agent is wrong

• Strong track record of forming effective cross-functional partnerships and communicating analysis clearly to technical and executive audiences

• Ability to research and learn new technologies, tools, and methodologies, and to thrive in a dynamic environment — finding opportunities and executing in both independent and collaborative environments

• 401k Match to help you save for your future (50% of your contribution up to the first 6% of your eligible pay)

• Monthly stipend to support your work and productivity

• US employees receive 12 paid holidays per year

• Opportunities for professional growth and development including access to Udemy online courses

3cd4f0e4c1d7619d.description:
hoichoi is India's leading Bengali OTT platform — the digital arm of SVF, Eastern India's largest media & entertainment company. We stream 650+ Bengali movies, 185+ originals, and 3000+ hours of content to a global audience of ~250 million Bengalis across India, Bangladesh, and 100+ countries. We're part of a wider ecosystem alongside Sooper (AI-led micro-drama OTT) and LoglineAI (AI-native creative studio), and we're on a mission to entertain everyone in their native language.

The Opportunity
We're hiring a Senior Product Analyst to become the first dedicated owner of product analytics at hoichoi. We've been running PostHog for a few months, with real event data flowing across all platforms — what's missing is someone who digs into the data unprompted and turns it into a clear case for what we should change, and why. You'll sit inside the Product & Data team and work closely with Engineering, Payments, and Programming to move two numbers: revenue and user experience.

This is not a reporting service desk. As the first dedicated hire in this function, you will define how it works rather than inherit it. Your output is decisions, not dashboards — finding the exact step where a subscriber drops off, and owning a recommendation through to whether the number actually moved. We want someone who's done this before, checks the data before forming a view, and is comfortable reporting a flat result honestly. This is a full-time, in-office role based in Kolkata.

What You'll Do

Drop-off Analysis
• Map every meaningful journey on every platform and find the exact step where users leave: onboarding, login and signup, search, content discovery, playback start, and the subscription funnel.
• Own the subscription funnel end to end — app open → paywall viewed → plan selected → payment initiated → payment success — split by platform, geography, and payment method.
• For every drop-off found, report how many users and how much revenue it costs, why it's happening, and what specifically should change.
• Analyse payment failures and retry behaviour alongside the payments team.
• Track whether each recommended fix moved the number, and report plainly if it didn't.
Retention, Churn & Cohorts
• Build and maintain retention and cohort views — day-1/7/30, trial-to-paid, renewal, and cancellation.
• Identify first-session and first-week behaviours that predict a subscriber sticking around, and recommend how to engineer more of them.
Content & Programming Analytics
• Report on content performance — tray impressions and clicks, play starts, completion rates, drop-off curves, and search behaviour.
• Feed insights back to the programming team on what to promote, tray order, and whether an underperforming release was a content or merchandising issue.
• Support the internal Programming Analyst tooling built on top of PostHog.
Experimentation
• Set up and read A/B tests and feature-flag rollouts in PostHog — paywall variants, onboarding flows, tray layouts.
• Define success metrics and guardrail metrics up front, and call results honestly, including flat ones.
Reporting Rhythm
• Run a weekly product metrics review that people actually read, and a monthly deep dive on one problem area of your choosing.
• Deliver release-impact analysis after every major app release.

Must-Have Qualifications :
• 4–6 years in product analytics, growth analytics, or data analysis on a consumer (B2C) product — app or web — including experience mentoring or setting standards for others.
• Hands-on ownership of a product analytics tool (PostHog, Mixpanel, Amplitude, CleverTap, or similar) — has defined events, built funnels, and debugged bad data, not just consumed dashboards someone else built.
• Demonstrated ability to find drop-offs and act on them, with a concrete example of a funnel fixed, what was found, what changed, and what it was worth.
• Solid grasp of funnels, cohorts, retention curves, and segmentation.
• Comfortable working with AI tooling day to day — specifically the PostHog MCP server with Claude — and able to get MCP running within a week if new to it.
• Willing to check the data and then take a decision: form a view, recommend it clearly, and own the outcome.
• Able to write a clear recommendation — what the data says, what to do about it, and how confident to be.
• Self-directed, arriving with questions rather than waiting for answers.

Candidates must have experience in any product analytics tool: PostHog, Mixpanel, Amplitude, CleverTap or similar. 

Why Join hoichoi
You'll be the first dedicated product analytics hire at India's leading Bengali OTT platform — defining how the function works rather than inheriting someone else's playbook, with real event data across six platforms from day one. Every recommendation you make has a direct line to revenue and to how millions of viewers experience the product. hoichoi is going all-in on becoming AI-native, so you'll work daily with the PostHog MCP server and Claude as part of your core workflow, with a clear path to owning a growing analytics function as it scales.

Culture & How We Work
At hoichoi, the best idea wins, not the biggest title. We operate in small, cross-functional teams that argue productively and ship fast. Ownership isn't a buzzword here; it's the default setting — if something's broken, you fix it rather than filing a ticket and waiting.

We ship fast, measure what works, and iterate. Some releases — particularly TV platform and store submissions — land outside standard hours, and we expect flexibility around those windows. We're equally serious about keeping the pace sustainable the rest of the time.

About the Team

Netlify is a product-led growth company with an unusually large organic top-of-funnel, where tens of thousands of people discover and sign up for Netlify every day. That organic motion is real and meaningful, but paid acquisition is a new investment area for the marketing team, and there's a clear opportunity to build that capability from the ground up. 

As Senior Manager, Demand Generation & Performance Marketing, you'll own paid acquisition end to end - strategy, channel selection, budget, and the agency relationship that supports execution. You'll report to the CMO, with a planned transition to the VP of Growth Marketing as that function scales, and work closely with Marketing Operations, Data, Lifecycle, and Campaigns to make sure paid-acquired users don't just land, but convert and stick. This is a builder role at a company where the organic foundation is already strong, and your job is to build the paid layer that extends its reach.

What You'll Do

• Build and own Netlify's paid acquisition strategy end to end, including paid search, paid social, retargeting, sponsorships, and any other channels worth testing and proving out. 

• Own the call on where paid creates incremental value for Netlify. Design the tests, prove which channels and audiences drive growth our organic funnel wouldn't have delivered anyway, and decide where to scale, where to hold, and where not to spend at all.

• Manage the agency relationship(s) supporting paid/performance work by setting the brief, holding the agency accountable to targets, and deciding what to bring in-house as the function matures.

• Own budget planning, pacing, and ROI reporting for all paid spend, and make the case for where to double down or pull back.

• Partner with Marketing Operations to get attribution and UTM tracking right before scaling spend, so every dollar is measurable.

• Define target audiences and channel mix aligned to Netlify's ICP; partner with Product Marketing on messaging inputs for paid creative.

• Build the measurement framework for CAC, signup/pipeline contribution, and payback by channel.

• Partner with Lifecycle and Campaigns to make sure paid-acquired users flow into the right onboarding and activation journeys, not just land and drop off.

• As the program proves out, build the roadmap and case for a fully staffed paid/performance team.

What You'll Bring

• 6+ years in demand generation or performance marketing, with direct ownership of a paid acquisition budget in a B2B SaaS or product-led growth environment

• Hands-on experience running paid search, paid social, and retargeting programs yourself - not just briefing agencies or reviewing their reports

• A track record of standing up or significantly scaling a paid acquisition program at an early stage, where you had to build the infrastructure and not just optimize what was already there

• Experience managing an external agency or partner relationship, including setting performance expectations and holding partners accountable to them

• Working knowledge of attribution and marketing measurement, and a history of partnering with Marketing Ops or Data teams to get tracking right before spend scales

• Some experience marketing to developers or technical audiences, or with a PLG motion where paid acquisition runs alongside a large organic and self-serve funnel

This Role Is a Great Fit If

• You're energized by building and scaling a new paid program, not just optimizing one that's already mature.

• You think like an owner of budget and outcomes, not just a briefs-and-reports manager of an agency.

• You're comfortable moving between strategy (channel mix, targeting, budget allocation) and getting into the details yourself when it matters.

• You care about attribution being right before spend scales, not as an afterthought.

• You want to build in close partnership with Lifecycle, Campaigns, and Marketing Ops rather than run paid as a separate lane that hands off a spreadsheet at the end of the quarter
